property_summary: For any caller and any nonzero _timestamp, setL1BlockValues either reverts (non-depositor) or leaves c.timestamp() unchanged (== 0), so c.timestamp() never equals _timestamp after the call; the mutant, when the depositor account calls with a nonzero _timestamp, stores it, making c.timestamp() == _timestamp.
change_summary: Insert assignment timestamp = _timestamp; so after a successful call, timestamp reflects the passed value instead of staying 0.
